title: Müller to Bartsch, 8 May 1631
author: Philipp Müller
source: Philipp Müller's reply to Jacob Bartsch, written at Leipzig on 8 May 1631: on the tables and copies Bartsch had sent, the second volume of the *Ephemerides*, a christening gift for Kepler's grandson, and the funeral poems for Kepler, with a passage quoted from a letter of Peter Crüger. The letter is among the Kepler manuscripts at the Pulkovo Observatory (vol. XI), where von Dyck found it. Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 103–104.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Müller replies to Bartsch about the copies he has received and their prices, advises printing the second volume of the *Ephemerides* at home, sends a gift for Kepler's grandson, and quotes Crüger's excuse for writing no poem on Kepler's death.

notes.on: the will shall always be there
notes.note: After Ovid, *Epistulae ex Ponto* 3.4.79: “though the strength be lacking, the will is to be praised.”
